thread:
sam: Noticed a small but growing regression in eu-west-2 after runtime 4.2.0 went live. Client negotiation failures for quant-small models around 300-500 tokens. Reverted nodes locally to 4.1.8 and errors dropped. Requesting a region-scoped soft-pin to 4.1.8 while SDK investigates.
toni: Can you share the short error snippet and the measured impact?
sam: error: "negotiation: unsupported_option 0x0f at step features". Telemetry: https://telemetry.redwood/eu-west-2/negotiation -> negotiation_fail_rate: 1.5% region, baseline <0.1%. Small customer retries observed.
zach: Repro: sdk-test --model quant-small --seq 450 --sdk 2.8.7 --runtime 4.2.0 -> consistent. SDK team filed PR 4978 to relax negotiation parsing.
emily: Suggest soft-pin only at routing for eu-west-2 so we don't affect global rollout. Confirm Dedicated infra unaffected.
toni: Dedicated unaffected; we control hosted routing.
deploybot: pin_request ID=PIN-7722 created by sam. scope=region:eu-west-2, target_runtime=4.1.8, type=soft, expires=2026-04-05T06:00:00Z, reason="client negotiation regression after runtime 4.2.0 rollout (quant-small)". Pending approvals: release-leads + oncall.
ops-bot: Runbook: https://runbook.redwood/pins -> steps: apply soft-pin, warm kv-cache, monitor negotiation_fail_rate for 30m, rollback procedure included.
zach: Proposed plan: apply soft-pin in 10m, run 5% canary to 4.2.0 concurrently for 45m to observe unpin behavior, success criteria: negotiation_fail_rate <0.2% and no p99 latency spike. If fail_rate >0.5% within 30m -> rollback unpin to 4.2.0 and escalate SDK.
emily: add synthetic probe hitting quant-small longseq path every 90s. Also add a log filter for duplicate request ids to catch masked retries.
toni: SDK PR link?
sam: PR 4978: https://git.redwood/sdk/pull/4978 - negotiation parser tolerance. CI green locally but integration flaky on legacy-negotiation tests.
deploybot: Action created: PIN-7722 scheduled to apply in 8m after approvals.
ops-bot: Checklist: [x] pin request created PIN-7722, [ ] approvals, [ ] pin applied, [ ] canary active, [ ] rollback criteria set.
toni: approve
zach: approve
deploybot: Approvals recorded. Applying PIN-7722 now.
emily: Canary active; routing shows 5% to 4.2.0, rest to 4.1.8 in eu-west-2. Dashboards: https://telemetry.redwood/eu-west-2/overview.
sam: Early numbers (7m): negotiation_fail_rate -> 0.12% after pin. p99 latency steady. Looks promising.
zach: Keep an eye for regressions when we later unpin; recommend staged unpin: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 30-60m observation windows.
toni: If we need to extend past 48h, coordinate customer comms.
sam: release note stub: https://git.redwood/release-notes/3418 - "eu-west-2 temporarily routes to runtime 4.1.8 after client negotiation regressions affecting quant-small; SDK PR 4978 in progress."
ops-bot: Reminder: file postmortem ticket and include failing test id (legacy-neg-450) and SDK PR number.
emily: All good. Will update thread with final unpin decision.
